options.content:
# Thermostat Fleet Demo

Monte Carlo simulation of an IoT thermostat fleet on DynamoDB.

Models: on-demand throttling, hot partitions, burst capacity, GSI write amplification, and LSI item-collection limits. Multi-region batches additionally model global-table replication with cross-region transfer costs.

- Batch ID: `${batch_id}`
- Scenario ID: `${scenarioId}`
- Trial Count: `${trialCount}`
- Simulation Ticks: `${simulationTicks}`
- Window Size (s): `${windowSizeSeconds}`

panels.description: Windowed ReadCapacityUnits percentile bands across trials.

targets.rawSql:
with percentiles as (
  select
    window_start_tick,
    avg("value") as mean,
    percentile_cont(0.05) within group (order by "value") as p5,
    percentile_cont(0.25) within group (order by "value") as p25,
    percentile_cont(0.75) within group (order by "value") as p75,
    percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by "value") as p95
  from stochastacy_demo.trial_window_time_series
  where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
    and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
    and metric = 'ReadCapacityUnits'
    and window_size_seconds = cast('${windowSizeSeconds}' as integer)
  group by window_start_tick
)
select
  to_timestamp(window_start_tick) as "time",
  mean as "Mean",
  p95 as "P95",
  p75 as "P75",
  p25 as "P25",
  p5 as "P5",
  p95 as "Band P95-P75",
  p75 as "Band P75-P25",
  p25 as "Band P25-P5"
from percentiles
order by window_start_tick;

panels.description: Total cross-region data transfer bytes over the simulation (multi-region only). One bar per directional region pair.

targets.rawSql:
select
  metric as "Direction",
  avg("value") as "Mean Bytes"
from stochastacy_demo.trial_summary
where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
  and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
  and metric like 'CrossRegionTransfer:%:%:Bytes'
group by metric
order by metric;

panels.title: Cross-Region Transfer Bytes by Direction (mean across trials)

panels.description: Per-region write capacity total across all ticks (multi-region only). One bar per region.

targets.rawSql:
select
  split_part(metric, ':', 2) as "Region",
  avg("value") as "Mean WCU"
from stochastacy_demo.trial_summary
where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
  and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
  and metric like 'Region:%:TotalWriteCapacityUnits'
group by metric
order by metric;

list.definition: with stats as ( select max(case when statistic = 'mean' then "value" end) as mean_value, max(case when statistic = 'stddev' then "value" end) as stddev_value from stochastacy_demo.aggregate_summary where batch_id = '${batch_id}' and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}' and metric = 'TotalEstimatedCost' ) select concat(to_char(mean_value, 'FM$0.00000'), ' +/- ', to_char(stddev_value, 'FM$0.00000')) __text, concat(to_char(mean_value, 'FM$0.00000'), ' +/- ', to_char(stddev_value, 'FM$0.00000')) __value from stats

list.definition: with stats as ( select max(case when statistic = 'mean' then "value" end) as mean_value, max(case when statistic = 'stddev' then "value" end) as stddev_value from stochastacy_demo.aggregate_summary where batch_id = '${batch_id}' and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}' and metric = 'FinalStorageBytes' ), formatted as ( select case when abs(mean_value) >= 1073741824 then trim(to_char(mean_value / 1073741824.0, 'FM999999990.0')) || ' GiB' when abs(mean_value) >= 1048576 then trim(to_char(mean_value / 1048576.0, 'FM999999990.0')) || ' MiB' when abs(mean_value) >= 1024 then trim(to_char(mean_value / 1024.0, 'FM999999990.0')) || ' KiB' else trim(to_char(mean_value, 'FM999999990.0')) || ' B' end as mean_text, case when abs(stddev_value) >= 1073741824 then trim(to_char(stddev_value / 1073741824.0, 'FM999999990.0')) || ' GiB' when abs(stddev_value) >= 1048576 then trim(to_char(stddev_value / 1048576.0, 'FM999999990.0')) || ' MiB' when abs(stddev_value) >= 1024 then trim(to_char(stddev_value / 1024.0, 'FM999999990.0')) || ' KiB' else trim(to_char(stddev_value, 'FM999999990.0')) || ' B' end as stddev_text from stats ) select concat(mean_text, ' +/- ', stddev_text) __text, concat(mean_text, ' +/- ', stddev_text) __value from formatted
